== {{int:license-header}} ==
Regarding the origin and copyright status of this image it is a study by [https://www.galerie-fach.de/index.php/en/schmutzer-f the portraitist F. Schmutzer]{{Dead link|date=November 2023 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}, a member of the [[Wikipedia:Vienna Secession]] and its president from 1914 to 1917. Schmutzer did not intend his studies to be published, [http://www.donau-uni.ac.at/imperia/md/content/studium/kultur/zbw/eshph/photoresearcher/photoresearcher_no8.pdf they were for his own private use] {{Wayback|url=http://www.donau-uni.ac.at/imperia/md/content/studium/kultur/zbw/eshph/photoresearcher/photoresearcher_no8.pdf |date=20120904052800 }}. His studies were discovered in 2001 and sold to the Austrian National Library. It follows that this image could not have been published before 2001 and thus not within 70 years of its creation (1921). The image was the subject of a nomination for deletion and [[Commons:Deletion requests/File:Einstein 1921 by F Schmutzer.jpg |the result was a '''keep''']].
